mcat_description.short: Poultry sheds are prefabricated or site-fabricated agricultural structures designed for commercial housing of broiler, layer, or breeder birds, supplied as steel-frame, RCC, or pre-engineered building systems with open-sided, semi-EC, or fully environmentally controlled (EC) configurations.
mcat_description.long: Poultry sheds in the Indian B2B market are purpose-built agricultural housing structures for commercial poultry farming, ranging from simple open-sided MS angle-frame sheds to fully automated Environmentally Controlled (EC) sheds with tunnel ventilation, evaporative cooling pads, and automated feeding and watering systems. They are supplied as prefabricated steel structures, pre-engineered buildings (PEB), RCC-frame constructions, or cement-pole sheds, and are customised to bird capacity (typically 5,000–30,000 birds per shed), shed dimensions, and farming type (broiler, layer, or breeder). The EC shed segment is the fastest-growing sub-type in India, driven by superior feed conversion ratios, lower bird mortality, and year-round climate independence compared to conventional open-sided houses. Buyers are commercial poultry farmers, contract farmers under integrator programmes, and poultry farm setup contractors seeking turnkey construction or structural supply.
primary_applications: Commercial broiler chicken rearing (floor-based, 5,000–30,000 birds per shed)
Layer hen egg production (cage-based or cage-free)
Breeder flock housing for parent stock
Pullet rearing before transfer to layer sheds
Contract farming under poultry integrator programmes (ABIS, Suguna, Venky's)

market_context: The Indian poultry shed market is bifurcated between conventional open-sided sheds (lower investment, natural ventilation, suitable for smaller operations and moderate climates) and Environmentally Controlled (EC) sheds (higher investment, tunnel ventilation with exhaust fans and evaporative cooling pads, automated feeding/watering/lighting, suitable for large-scale commercial operations). EC sheds are the dominant and fastest-growing segment in India, driven by superior feed conversion ratios, lower bird mortality, and year-round climate independence; research confirms that while investment per bird is higher in EC housing, returns are significantly higher due to higher production standards. Structural systems used in India include MS angle-frame fabrication, GI (galvanised iron) structures, RCC (reinforced cement concrete) frame, cement-pole construction, and pre-engineered buildings (PEB) with sandwich/PUF panel cladding. Shed sizing in the Indian market is primarily expressed in bird capacity (5,000 to 30,000 birds per shed), with shed width for open-sided designs typically not exceeding 22–25 feet per TNAU agricultural guidelines to ensure adequate natural ventilation. Key Indian manufacturers and suppliers include Kishore Infratech (Hyderabad), Pressmach, Industrial Foams Pvt. Ltd., Tradewill Prefab, and Benir Built Infra; major integrators such as ABIS actively support contract farmers in EC shed adoption. The market is geographically concentrated in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Bihar (Sasaram region visible in keyword data), reflecting India's major poultry farming belts.
